title: Went Streaking Through MallWorld Last Night 🤣 Apologies If You Saw That
content: I was supposed to be doing some computer work in a very crowded, large office space. There were rows and rows of tables in a big open room, with lots of computer workers. I discovered that someone had stolen the monitor from my station, and I couldn't work. I got really angry, and ripped off all my clothes LoL. Then I ran through the office, when I found the exit it lead out into mall world. I then gleefully ran naked through a bunch of crowded mall corridors. Not sure where I ended up, but getting out of that office was sweet freedom.
